tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.4.4 — Dense Cursive Handwriting Line Segmentation Fix (Recover Full Paragraphs on Tightly Spaced & Unruled Pages)
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.4.4 fixes an issue where pages of tightly spaced Hebrew cursive handwriting (where tall letters like ל and descenders touch neighboring lines) could have the entire main paragraph skipped during scanning, leaving only 1–2 isolated header words like בס"ד. The line segmenter now recognizes dense multi-line text blocks, tracks line valleys sequentially on unruled pages, and measures line spacing accurately even on half-filled pages.
features: Dense Multi-Line Paragraph Recovery: Previously, when 12+ closely spaced handwritten lines touched via ascenders/descenders, the page segmenter mistook the merged paragraph for a box outline and dropped it. Ohr HaKsav now distinguishes solid text blocks from hollow boxes so every line in dense Torah notes is preserved and transcribed.

Valley-Following Line Splitting for Unruled Paper: For tall merged paragraphs (4+ lines), the splitter now refines line spacing locally and follows the actual white-space gaps line by line, preventing cuts from drifting into text when handwriting spacing varies naturally across unruled pages.

Improved Line-Spacing Detection on Half-Filled Pages: Line-pitch estimation now focuses on the active ink region (ignoring large blank top/bottom margins) and supports smaller, more compact handwriting.
Fast ~49 MB Delta Patch Ready (engineVersion 1.4): Existing v1.4.0–v1.4.3 installations automatically download only the slim ~49 MB SHA-256-verified patch.
